summary: The candidate is a genuine partial mitigation: a per-process, per-bootstrap fixed 10 ms gate reduces scheduler-cycle DP-rank queries, and its regression passes. It does not bound retries, back off exponentially, fail an unreachable bootstrap, coordinate once per node, or demonstrate successful serving, so the original zero-success deadlock and ongoing multi-rank retry stream remain possible.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison against recorded base: unresolved lookup submitted on 3 of 3 cycles rather than 2, and the candidate throttle helper did not exist.
Candidate regression and neighboring queue cleanup coverage: 11 passed.

Independent contract counterexamples: 3374 permitted attempts for one rank over 60 simulated seconds, 680 permitted attempts across eight independent ranks over one simulated second, and no retry-cap state.

gpu_execution_evidence: The prepared interpreter detected one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, and HIP 7.2.26015. No GPU computation was used as evidence for this CPU-side HTTP scheduling change.
remaining_counterexamples: A permanently unreachable bootstrap remains eligible for queries indefinitely; there is no bounded retry count or terminal failure path for DP-rank lookup.
Each decode DP-rank process owns independent throttle state, so TP8/EP8/DP8 still multiplies attempts across ranks rather than querying once per node.
The fixed 10 ms interval is not exponential backoff and still permits hundreds of aggregate attempts per second across eight ranks.
The request can remain pending forever with zero successful requests; the candidate only lowers retry frequency.
No two-node model-serving evidence demonstrates elimination of the reported Errno 99 ephemeral-port exhaustion.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU and one node were assigned; the original two-node TP8/EP8/DP8 MoRI topology could not be run.
The exact Errno 99 failure and full serving success were not reproduced.
The candidate changed no native source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
